At the grocery store, an Asian woman and a Black woman were finishing their shopping and each had a whole cart full of food for the week, as they each had a pretty big family. Once they got to checkout, the Asian woman got through everything quickly because she just handed the cashier cash, but it took awhile longer for the Black woman, since the cashier had to remove several items that couldn't be purchased using her benefits card. Who buys food with cash?
A. Can't be determined
B. The Black woman
C. The Asian woman
